name: Lateral Banded Walk
instructions: Place a resistance band around your legs just above the knees or ankles.
Stand with feet hip-width apart, knees slightly bent in a quarter squat.
Step sideways, keeping tension on the band.
Bring your trailing foot in without letting the feet come fully together.
Take steps in one direction, then return.
longevityNotes: Squatting is the foundation of getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs. Keeping leg strength and knee range preserves independence decades longer than any single other movement.
overview: A side-stepping exercise with a band around the legs that trains the glute medius and hip abductors.
